title: Whether a completion file's image renders in an editor's hover has never been checked.
text: Goal `completion-files` ended with one hand check left: open a completion file with an image link in the Extension Development Host and see whether the hover shows the image. A loop session cannot run that check, and this module's doc records no result. The goal accepted the text rendering as a fallback. Closing this is the user's check, and its result is written into this module's doc.
